parameters.content:
## ⏰ AUTOMATIC REMINDERS

### Tasks:
Checks the task table every minute and sends reminders to executors.

**Priorities:**
- 🔴 High
- 🟡 Medium
- 🟢 Low
- ⚠️ Reminder

## ⏰ AUTOMATIC REMINDERS PHOTO REPORTS

### Photo journal:
Checks the table every minute and sends reminders to send photo reports.

**Logic:**
- Checks the time of sending
- Generates a list of recipients
- Sends personalized messages
- Updates the sending status

parameters.content:
## 🔧 SERVICE COMMANDS

### Available commands:
- **/start** - system registration
- **/help** - work guide
- **/status** - report status for the day
- **/report** - manual report sending
- **/read** - confirm reading (photos)
- **/received** - confirm receiving (tasks)

## 👤 REGISTRATION BLOCK

### Process of registering new executors:
1. **Check registration** - checks if user is in the database
2. **Request data** - if new, requests name and company
3. **Save to table** - writes data to Google Sheets
4. **Confirmation** - sends welcome message

parameters.content:
## 🔄 PHOTO PROCESSING FLOW

1. User replies to reminder with photo
2. System extracts Task ID from reminder text
3. Photo is uploaded to Google Drive
4. Checks for existing entry in table
5. If entry exists - adds to existing
6. If not - creates new entry
7. Sends confirmation

## 📸 PHOTO REPORT PROCESSING

### Main functionality:

1. **Data extraction** - parsing Task ID from message
2. **Upload to Drive** - saving photo to Google Drive
3. **Grouping** - combining multiple photos of one task
4. **Writing to table** - updating or creating entry
5. **Confirmation** - notification of successful upload

parameters.content:
## 📍 GEOLOCATION PROCESSING

### GPS Coordinates:

- Link to existing report
- Save coordinates and map link
- Update record in the table

## 📊 DATA STRUCTURE

### Google Sheets Tables:
1. **Users** - data of registered users
2. **Photo Reports** - all photo reports
3. **Tasks** - list of tasks and their statuses

### Key Fields:
- **Task ID** / **Report ID** - unique identifier
- **Executor ID** - Telegram Chat ID
- **Status** - task completion status

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTES
1. **Task ID = Report ID** - these are the same identifier
2. **File Grouping** - multiple photos can relate to one task
3. **Recurring Reminders** - sent at specified intervals
4. **Time Validation** - accounts for Europe/Minsk timezone

## 🚀 ENTRY POINT

### Telegram Webhook

Handles all incoming messages from users:
- Commands (/start, /help, /status, etc.)
- Photos for reports
- Text reports on tasks
- Geolocation

## 📋 TEXT REPORT PROCESSING

### Task Reports:

- Verify task owner
- Parse status (completed/partially/not completed)
- Update status in the tasks table
- Send confirmation to the executor

name: Chat with local LLMs using n8n and Ollama
description: ## Chat with local LLMs using n8n and Ollama This n8n workflow allows you to seamlessly interact with your self-hosted Large Language Models (LLMs) through a user-friendly chat interface. By connecting to Ollama, a powerful tool for…

workflow_json.name: Chat with local LLMs using n8n and Ollama

parameters.content:
## Chat with local LLMs using n8n and Ollama
This n8n workflow allows you to seamlessly interact with your self-hosted Large Language Models (LLMs) through a user-friendly chat interface. By connecting to Ollama, a powerful tool for managing local LLMs, you can send prompts and receive AI-generated responses directly within n8n.

### How it works
1. When chat message received: Captures the user's input from the chat interface.
2. Chat LLM Chain: Sends the input to the Ollama server and receives the AI-generated response.
3. Delivers the LLM's response back to the chat interface.

### Set up steps
* Make sure Ollama is installed and running on your machine before executing this workflow.
* Edit the Ollama address if different from the default.

## Ollama setup
* Connect to your local Ollama, usually on http://localhost:11434
* If running in Docker, make sure that the n8n container has access to the host's network in order to connect to Ollama. You can do this by passing `--net=host` option when starting the n8n Docker container

parameters.content:
## Bitcoin price alert (CoinPaprika, no API key)

Polls the free, keyless CoinPaprika API every 15 minutes and sends a Telegram message when Bitcoin moves 5% or more (up or down) over 24h.

**Setup**
1. Add your Telegram credential to the *Send Telegram alert* node.
2. Set your chat id in that node (replace YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID).

**Customize**
- Track another coin: change `btc-bitcoin` in the HTTP node to any CoinPaprika id (e.g. `eth-ethereum`, `sol-solana`).
- Change the 5% threshold in the *Big 24h move?* node.

No API key or signup is required. Data: https://api.coinpaprika.com

description: ## Post new live tennis matches to Discord ### What it does - Every 5 minutes, fetches the currently live tennis matches from the Live Tennis API (`GET /matches?status=live`). - Splits the response into one item per match. - **Remove…

parameters.content:
## Post new live tennis matches to Discord

### What it does
- Every 5 minutes, fetches the currently live tennis matches from the Live Tennis API (`GET /matches?status=live`).
- Splits the response into one item per match.
- **Remove Duplicates** (seen in previous executions) keeps only matches that are newly live, so each match is announced **once**.
- Posts a short message to a Discord channel via an Incoming Webhook.

### Setup (~5 min)
1. Get a free API key (live scores, no card): https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free
2. In the **HTTP Request** node, create a **Header Auth** credential:
   - Name: `X-API-Key`
   - Value: your API key
3. In the **Discord** node, add a **Discord Webhook** credential (a Discord channel Incoming Webhook URL).
4. Activate the workflow.

Base URL: `https://api.livetennisapi.com/api/public/v1`. Free tier = 30 req/min, 100 req/day, so a 5-minute schedule stays well within limits. Prefer a dedicated node? Swap the HTTP Request for the community node `n8n-nodes-livetennisapi`.

_Disclosure: this template is contributed by the team behind the Live Tennis API — judge it on the merits._
=🎾 New live match: {{ $json.players.p1.name }} vs {{ $json.players.p2.name }} — {{ $json.status }}

name: 02 - Promemoria scadenze pagamenti
description: ## ⚙️ CONFIGURAZIONE (5 min) 1. **Google Sheets**: prepara un foglio 'Fatture' con le colonne: `Numero | Cliente | Email | Importo | Scadenza (gg/mm/aaaa) | Stato` Lo Stato deve essere `Pagata` oppure `Da pagare`. 2. Collega le credenziali…

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ CONFIGURAZIONE (5 min)

1. **Google Sheets**: prepara un foglio 'Fatture' con le colonne:
   `Numero | Cliente | Email | Importo | Scadenza (gg/mm/aaaa) | Stato`
   Lo Stato deve essere `Pagata` oppure `Da pagare`.
2. Collega le credenziali Google nel nodo 'Leggi fatture' e seleziona il foglio.
3. **Gmail**: collega l'account che invierà i solleciti.
4. Il controllo parte ogni mattina alle 8:00. Invia il promemoria se la scadenza è tra 3 giorni o se è già passata.

💡 Personalizza il testo dell'email nel nodo 'Invia sollecito' con il tono della tua azienda.

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.scaduta ? 'Promemoria: fattura ' + $json.Numero + ' scaduta' : 'Promemoria: fattura ' + $json.Numero + ' in scadenza' }}
parameters.message:
=Gentile {{ $json.Cliente }},

le ricordiamo che la fattura n. {{ $json.Numero }} di € {{ $json.Importo }} {{ $json.scaduta ? 'risulta scaduta il' : 'è in scadenza il' }} {{ $json.scadenzaTesto }}.

Se il pagamento è già stato effettuato, la preghiamo di ignorare questo messaggio.

Per qualsiasi chiarimento siamo a disposizione.

Cordiali saluti,
[LA TUA AZIENDA]
